dimension-specific-emergence.statement: Some start conditions can emerge more strongly when started directly in 3D than in 2D.
dimension-specific-emergence.counter_statement: Any apparent 3D advantage disappears under paired comparisons or fresh seeds.
dimension-specific-emergence.falsification_condition: Repeated paired trials show no positive 3D-minus-2D Level difference.

three-vortex-triangle-fission.statement: When three naturally formed vortices make a robust triangle, a nearby structure may later split into separate groups more often.
three-vortex-triangle-fission.counter_statement: The triangle is only a coincidence; later splitting is no more likely than in other vortex arrangements.
three-vortex-triangle-fission.falsification_condition: Many naturally observed triangles are followed by no excess of persistent split-like geometry compared with controls.

triangle-balance-break-fission.statement: A persistent triangle may be a temporary stable relation; loss of its balance while still connected may predict a later split better than triangle presence alone.
triangle-balance-break-fission.counter_statement: Apparent balance loss is incidental and does not increase later split probability.
triangle-balance-break-fission.falsification_condition: Across repeated matched triangle cases, collapse-before-split is no more predictive than triangles without measured collapse.
